Research direction · 03

Model Security: Local LLMs & Trustworthy Agents

Our published work examines jailbreaks, adversarial preferences, noisy feedback, and robust agent representations. We are bringing those findings into repeatable evaluations for language models and agents, including systems deployed locally.

Local deploymentLLM alignmentAgent safetyEvaluation harnesses

Research focus

What we study.

01

Local & private deployment

Study model adaptation and evaluation choices for settings where data or models need to remain under local control.

02

Robust alignment

Test how prompt attacks, adversarial preferences, and noisy feedback affect model behaviour.

03

Agent evaluation harnesses

Develop repeatable checks for agent behaviour before systems with tools or memory are put into use.
